subject: [RFC PATCH v3 6/8] mm/gup: return a huge page's full count from follow_page_mask()

2026-08-11.patch_summary: This patch modifies the follow_page_mask() function in the Linux kernel's mm/gup module to return the full count of huge pages instead of just a mask. The changes also simplify the code by removing unnecessary variables and loops, and add an explicit check for the -EEXIST path when pages are NULL. The patch does not change the behavior of follow_page_pte(), which still returns at most 1 page.
